# Mixed-origin private-input proof

`before.png` and `after.png` are direct element screenshots of the actual synthetic QA Bot reply, captured at the same 1440 × 1000 viewport. The screenshots are cropped by the browser, without image generation or altered reply content. `proof.json` is an allowlisted projection of the checked Runtime origin, native Tool result and Human approval.

See [the qualification note](../../../docs/qa/2290-private-input-origin.md) for source commits, reproducible steps, automated guard coverage and limits. No raw Session, private-account reference, login metadata or real credential is included.
